home.subtitle: Send your first bulk email in 5 minutes. Follow the steps below in order.
home.step1Desc: Set up Gmail, Outlook, or your own SMTP.
home.step2Desc: Drag and drop your Excel or CSV file.
home.quickSendReady: You're all set. Start a new send from here.
home.quickSendNotReady: Complete the 3 steps first, then start sending from here.

contacts.title: All Contacts
contacts.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or company…
contacts.emptyTitle: You don't have any contacts yet.
contacts.emptyDesc: Import your Excel file or add contacts manually.
contacts.confirmRemoveOne: Are you sure you want to delete "{email}"?
contacts.confirmRemoveMany: Are you sure you want to delete {n} contacts?

form.duplicateEmail: This email address is already registered.

groups.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the group "{name}"? Contacts will not be deleted.

import.title: Import from Excel
import.subtitle: Select your Excel or CSV file, map the columns, and import.
import.customFieldsNote: Unmapped columns are saved as custom fields ({{Column}}).
import.emailRequired: You must map the Email column.
import.doneDuplicates: {n} emails skipped because they were already registered.

templates.title: Templates
templates.selectDesc: Pick a template from the left panel or create a new one. Templates can contain variables like {example1}, {example2}.
templates.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the template "{name}"?

editor.name: Template name
editor.subject: Subject
editor.placeholder: Write your email here. Use the right panel for variables.

variables.hint: Click to add to subject or body. They'll be replaced with each contact's data on send.

preview.title: Template preview
preview.subtitle: See how the template will look with selected contact data.
preview.noContacts: You need at least one contact to preview. Add one from the Contacts tab first.
preview.draftNote: Showing preview of an unsaved template.

sending.title: New Campaign
sending.subtitle: Send bulk emails in 4 steps.
sending.noSmtpDesc: To send bulk emails, you must first connect a Gmail, Outlook, or custom SMTP account from Settings.
sending.noTemplateDesc: To send bulk emails, you must create at least one template from the Templates tab.
sending.noTemplatesYet: No templates yet. Create one from the Templates tab.

settings.rateHint: Slower sending reduces the risk of being marked as spam.
settings.scheduleHint: Leave empty to start immediately. Scheduled sends won't run if the app is closed.

confirm.doubleCheckBody: You're about to send emails to {count} contacts from {from}. Once started you can pause or cancel, but sent emails cannot be recalled.

reports.title: Reports
reports.emptyDesc: Start your first campaign from the Send tab.
reports.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the campaign "{name}"? Detail logs will also be deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your SMTP accounts here. Passwords are encrypted on your computer.

updates.macManualBody: Auto-update is not active for the macOS build yet (it requires code signing). Please download the new version manually from bilgetek.com/maildrop.
updates.upToDateBody: v{version} is the most recent release. No update available.
updates.newVersionBody: Download the update to get the latest features and bug fixes.
updates.downloadedBody: v{version} downloaded. When you click "Install now" the app will close and the new version will install.
updates.errorBody: Check your internet connection. If the problem persists you can download manually from bilgetek.com/maildrop.

promotions.label: Show Bilgetek promotion suggestions
promotions.hint: Occasionally when the app closes, you may see a suggestion for another product in the Bilgetek ecosystem. Turn this off if you'd prefer not to.

settings.emptyHint: Connect an email account first to send bulk mail.
settings.formCardDesc: Settings are auto-filled for Gmail, Outlook, and Yahoo. Choose "Custom SMTP" otherwise.
settings.editDesc: Leave the password empty to keep it unchanged.
settings.removeConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete the account "{name}"? Campaigns using it may be affected.

form.testHint: Test sends a sample email to your own address.

hints.gmail: Enter an app password as your password. You can create one from "App passwords" in your Google Account.
hints.outlook: If two-step verification is enabled, you'll need an app password.
hints.yahoo: You'll need to create an app password from your Yahoo account.
hints.custom: Enter your company's or hosting provider's SMTP details.

smtp.testSuccess: Connection successful. A test email was sent to your address — check your inbox.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.body: You can restart the app or refresh this screen. If the problem persists, share the error details.

smtp.authHint: If you use Gmail, you must sign in with an "app password" instead of your normal password.
smtp.timeoutHint: Check your internet connection. Are the host and port correct?
smtp.refusedHint: Check the port and SSL setting. Most providers use 465 (SSL) or 587 (TLS).
smtp.notfoundHint: The server address may be wrong, or you may be offline.
smtp.ssl: Server SSL certificate could not be verified.
smtp.sslHint: Try turning off SSL/TLS for this custom server or contact your admin.
smtp.spam: Server rejected the email (suspected spam or blacklist).
smtp.spamHint: Send to fewer people, slow down the rate, and review the content.
smtp.mailbox: Recipient address is invalid or not found.
smtp.mailboxHint: Make sure the email address is spelled correctly.
smtp.envelopeHint: Check the sender and recipient addresses.
smtp.unknownHint: See the technical message below for details.
smtp.attachmentMissingHint: The file you attached to the template has been deleted or moved. Edit the template and re-attach the file.

errors.dbNotInitHint: Restart the app. If the issue persists, share the log file.
errors.safeStorageHint: Your operating system's encryption service is disabled. Try restarting the system.
errors.pathInvalidHint: The file you selected is no longer accessible.
errors.pathOutsideHint: System folders are blocked. Use Documents/Downloads instead.

welcome.title: Welcome to MailDrop
welcome.subtitle: You'll send your first bulk email in 5 minutes. There are 3 things to do.
welcome.step1Desc: Gmail, Outlook, or your own SMTP.
welcome.step2Desc: Drag in your Excel or CSV file.
welcome.privacyBody: All your data stays on your computer. No information is sent to our servers. Your passwords are stored in your operating system's secure storage.

toast.smtpDeleteBlocked: This account is used by existing campaigns. Delete those campaigns from Reports first.
toast.templateDeleteBlocked: This template is used by existing campaigns. Delete those campaigns from Reports first.
toast.attachmentTooLarge: Attachment is {size} MB — Gmail and Outlook typically reject files larger than 25 MB.
